package.name: fr_description
package.description: Parametrized (xacro macro) robot description for Fairino collaborative robots, following the ur_description design: one macro generates the kinematic tree from per-model parameter files, with tf_prefix support for multi-robot setups. Model parameters and meshes were derived from the vendored Fairino URDFs (upstream: https://github.com/FAIR-INNOVATION/frcobot_ros2).
